79783.subject: Weekly Recap: Bitget's $387.5 Million Hack
79783.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

**Bitget**'s hot wallets sent about $387.5 million to attackers on Thursday afternoon, and the exchange has kept withdrawals switched off across every asset it lists since. It was the largest of five breaches this week.

Voting power bought for 20,199 USDC handed an attacker 11 **Neutron** contracts and kept the **Cosmos Hub** dark for almost 25 hours. **Payy** shut its payments network, cards included, over a forged $1.92 million withdrawal. **Duelbits** went offline after a $7 million hot-wallet drain, and old **Magic Eden** approvals let attackers pull NFTs and tokens until white hats moved 23,155 NFTs out of reach.

**Binance** bought $100 million of **Circle** stock at a 5% discount and signed five more years of the USDC fees Circle pays it. By Friday, Circle's CFO had announced he is leaving.

In their first full week under the SEC's exemption, tokenized stocks picked up an in-kind mint at **Ondo**, a 24/7 venue agreement between **NYSE** and Blockchain.com, a $500-minimum venture fund from **ARK** and a lending market at **Aave**. The **Fed** proposed capital rules for bank stablecoin issuers, and SEC staff published FAQs on buybacks and liquid staking.

Bitcoin touched $86,355 on Monday, its highest since January, and was back under the $86,000 ETF cost basis by Wednesday. **Zcash** cleared $1,600, a price it last saw in 2016.

Enjoy!

##### WATCH

## Synthetic vs. Direct Tokenized Stocks: Who Wins After The SEC Exemption?

Youtube: 🟢 LIVE : Synthetic vs. Direct Tokenized Stocks: Who Wins After The SEC Exemption? (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIMVROBpfEM)

Wednesday's stream took on the question under this week's Ondo, ARK and Aave launches: should a tokenized stock track a price, or be a claim on the share? Cooley partner **Rodrigo Seira** called the SEC exemption a five-year proof of concept, and Ondo's **Peter Curley** and Dinari's **Gabriel Otte** split over whether equity-linked notes clear the order's rights-equivalence bar. **[Watch the full conversation.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIMVROBpfEM)**

———————————————————————————

# Top Stories This Week

## Bitget Lost $387.5 Million From Its Hot Wallets And Froze Withdrawals

Bitget said unauthorized transfers hit a limited number of its hot wallets at 18:31 UTC on Thursday, [first putting the damage at $351.6 million](https://thedefiant.io/news/cefi/bitget-disables-withdrawals-165-million-one-address-four-chains) and suspending withdrawals across all 4,930 asset-network listings. On Friday it [raised the estimate to about $387.5 million](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/bitget-raises-hack-estimate-to-387-5-million-as-token-accounting-widens) after adding Zcash and TRON assets to the count. Explorer records show roughly 102.98 million XRP and 31,890 ETH leaving Bitget-labeled wallets, and Arkham traced the ether into eight fresh addresses holding about 68,300 ETH. Avalanche co-founder Emin Gün Sirer perhaps said it best during his fireside chat.
